text_en: Then Jesus said to the disciples, “There was a rich man who had a manager, and charges were brought to him that this man was squandering his property.
text_cn: 耶稣又对门徒们说：“曾有一个富翁，他有一个管家；有人在主人前告发这人挥霍了主人的财物。

text_en: So he summoned him and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give me an accounting of your management, because you cannot be my manager any longer. ’
text_cn: 主人便把他叫来，向他说：我怎么听说你有这样的事？把你管理家务的账目交出来，因为你不能再作管家了。

text_en: Then the manager said to himself, ‘What will I do, now that my master is taking the position away from me? I am not strong enough to dig, and I am ashamed to beg.
text_cn: 那管家自言自语道：主人要撤去我管家的职务，我可做什么呢？掘地罢，我没有气力；讨饭罢，我又害羞。

text_en: I have decided what to do so that, when I am dismissed as manager, people may welcome me into their homes. ’
text_cn: 我知道我要做什么，好叫人们，在我被撤去管家职务之后，收留我在他们家中。

text_en: So, summoning his master’s debtors one by one, he asked the first, ‘How much do you owe my master? ’
text_cn: 于是，他把主人的债户一一叫来，给第一个说：你欠我主人多少？

text_en: He answered, ‘A hundred jugs of olive oil. ’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it fifty. ’
text_cn: 那人说：一百桶油。管家向他说：拿你的账单，坐下快写作五十。

text_en: Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe? ’ He replied, ‘A hundred containers of wheat. ’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill and make it eighty. ’
text_cn: 随后，又给另一个说：你欠多少？那人说：一百石麦子。管家向他说：拿你的账单，写作八十。

text_en: And his master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly; for the children of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own generation than are the children of light.
text_cn: 主人遂称赞这个不义的管家，办事精明：这些今世之子应付自己的世代，比光明之子更为精明。

text_en: And I tell you, make friends for yourselves by means of dishonest wealth so that when it is gone, they may welcome you into the eternal homes.
text_cn: 我告诉你们：要用不义的钱财交结朋友，为在你们匮乏的时候，好叫他们收留你们到永远的帐幕里。

text_en: “Whoever is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much; and whoever is dishonest in a very little is dishonest also in much.
text_cn: 在小事上忠信的，在大事上也忠信；在小事上不义的，在大事上也不义。

text_en: If then you have not been faithful with the dishonest wealth, who will entrust to you the true riches?
text_cn: 那么，如果你们在不义的钱财上不忠信，谁还把真实的钱财委托给你们呢？

text_en: And if you have not been faithful with what belongs to another, who will give you what is your own?
text_cn: 如果你们在别人的财物上不忠信，谁还把属于你们的交给你们呢？

text_en: No slave can serve two masters; for a slave will either hate the one and love the other, or be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth. ”
text_cn: 没有一个家仆能事奉两个主人的：他或是要恨这一个而爱那一个，或是要依附这一个而轻忽那一个：你们不能事奉天主而又事奉钱财。”

text_en: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all this, and they ridiculed him.
text_cn: 爱财的法利塞人，听了这一切话，便嗤笑耶稣。

text_en: So he said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of others; but God knows your hearts; for what is prized by human beings is an abomination in the sight of God.
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“你们在人前自充义人，但是，天主知道你们的心，因为在人前是崇高的事，在天主前却是可憎的。

text_en: “The law and the prophets were in effect until John came; since then the good news of the kingdom of God is proclaimed, and everyone tries to enter it by force.
text_cn: 法律及先知到若翰为止，从此天主国的喜讯便传扬开来，人人都应奋勉进入。

text_en: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one stroke of a letter in the law to be dropped.
text_cn: 然而天地过去，比法律的一笔一画失落，还要容易。

text_en: “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery, and whoever marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.
text_cn: 凡休妻而另娶的，是犯奸淫；那娶人所休的妻子的，也是犯奸淫。”

text_en: “There was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and who feasted sumptuously every day.
text_cn: “有一个富家人，身穿紫红袍及细麻衣，天天奢华地宴乐。

text_en: And at his gate lay a poor man named Lazarus, covered with sores,
text_cn: 另有一个乞丐，名叫拉匝禄，满身疮痍，躺卧在他的大门前。

text_en: who longed to satisfy his hunger with what fell from the rich man’s table; even the dogs would come and lick his sores.
text_cn: 他指望藉富家人桌上掉下的碎屑充饥，但只有狗来舔他的疮痍。

text_en: The poor man died and was carried away by the angels to be with Abraham. The rich man also died and was buried.
text_cn: 那乞丐死了，天使把他送到亚巴郎的怀抱里。那个富人也死了，被人埋葬了。

text_en: In Hades, where he was being tormented, he looked up and saw Abraham far away with Lazarus by his side.
text_cn: 他在阴间，在痛苦中举目一望，远远看见亚巴郎及他怀抱中的拉匝禄，

text_en: He called out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue; for I am in agony in these flames. ’
text_cn: 便喊叫说：父亲亚巴郎！可怜我罢！请打发拉匝禄用他的指头尖，蘸点水来凉润我的舌头，因为我在这火焰中极其惨苦。

text_en: But Abraham said, ‘Child, remember that during your lifetime you received your good things, and Lazarus in like manner evil things; but now he is comforted here, and you are in agony.
text_cn: 亚巴郎说：孩子，你应记得你活着的时候，已享尽了你的福，而拉匝禄同样也受尽了苦。现在，他在这里受安慰，而你应受苦了。

text_en: Besides all this, between you and us a great chasm has been fixed, so that those who might want to pass from here to you cannot do so, and no one can cross from there to us. ’
text_cn: 除此之外，在我们与你们之间，隔着一个巨大的深渊，致使人即便愿意，从这边到你们那边去也不能，从那边到我们这里来也不能。

text_en: He said, ‘Then, father, I beg you to send him to my father’s house—
text_cn: 那人说：父亲！那么就请你打发拉匝禄到我父家去，

text_en: for I have five brothers—that he may warn them, so that they will not also come into this place of torment. ’
text_cn: 因为我有五个兄弟，叫他警告他们，免得他们也来到这痛苦的地方。

text_en: Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the prophets; they should listen to them. ’
text_cn: 亚巴郎说：他们自有梅瑟及先知，听从他们好了。

text_en: He said, ‘No, father Abraham; but if someone goes to them from the dead, they will repent. ’
text_cn: 他说：不，父亲亚巴郎！倘若有人从死者中到了他们那里，他们必会悔改。

text_en: He said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be convinced even if someone rises from the dead. ’”
text_cn: 亚巴郎给他说：如果他们不听从梅瑟及先知，纵使有人从死者中复活了，他们也必不信服。”
